headline: Prime SE angle, waist-high and cross-on — dawn log or nothing.
today: Prime direction and up to 2.5ft on the sets, but the SW is cross-on from dawn and only gets worse toward an onshore evening. Your window is first light on the incoming — soft and rideable, not clean. Log or fish, keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Still prime angle, smaller at under 2ft, but light W cross going cross-off. Cleanest day of the week here — worth a dawn log.
Flat and offshore. Nothing to ride. Pass.
